comments.author: Xunzhuo
comments.body:
@hsliuustc0106 I reran a stage-level A/B on `MI300X` for the CPU-side conversion and MP4 path.

Protocol:
- 209 float32 RGB frames at 1344x768, generated once per fresh process
- fixed moving-gradient content, 24 FPS, `ultrafast` encoder preset
- baseline is the pre-PR `np.stack -> clip -> scale -> round` implementation
- optimized is current head `82a142ad`
- three independent measured processes per implementation; values below are medians
- RSS sampled every 10 ms

| Stage / metric | Baseline | Optimized | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| frame conversion | 1201.15 ms | 529.47 ms | -55.9% (2.27x) |
| MP4 encode | 602.89 ms | 705.77 ms | unchanged code; run-to-run noise |
| conversion + MP4 | 1808.96 ms | 1235.26 ms | -31.7% |
| peak process RSS | 8.874 GiB | 4.141 GiB | -4.733 GiB (-53.3%) |
| peak RSS above resident input | 5.393 GiB | 0.660 GiB | -87.8% |

Stage timeline (median):

```text
baseline   [ conversion 1201.15 ms ][ MP4 602.89 ms ]  total 1808.96 ms
optimized  [ conversion  529.47 ms ][ MP4 705.77 ms ]  total 1235.26 ms
```

Correctness gate:
- uint8 frame SHA-256 is identical: `c423103a9b1ba9ea1ad7e78466c685a779148a87f5e625d9d4947834c798b19a`
- MP4 SHA-256 is identical: `a2b1b7d84f0e5e7fa72075fc679c54570354be10d0629850852e2ed5eba19339`
- `tests/entrypoints/openai_api/test_video_api_utils.py`: 13 passed on MI300X

The MP4 implementation is unchanged; the optimization is isolated to frame conversion and its temporary-buffer footprint.
